label: Zero Trust Architecture Assessment
description: Evaluates an organization's readiness for and progress toward zero trust architecture. Assesses identity, network, workload, and data security dimensions against NIST and vendor frameworks.

claudeKnowledge.description: NIST SP 800-207, CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model, DoD ZTA, vendor zero trust frameworks

guidedInputs.label: Current security architecture (as much as you know)
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe your current state:
- Identity provider (AD, Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace?)
- Network perimeter controls (VPN, firewall, VLAN segmentation?)
- Cloud environment (AWS, Azure, GCP, on-prem, hybrid?)
- Endpoint management (MDM, EDR, patch management?)
- Application access model (VPN-based, SaaS direct, on-prem apps?)
- Data classification and DLP tools?

guidedInputs.label: Primary security concerns driving this assessment
Regulatory or compliance requirements
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., NIS2 Directive compliance required by October 2024, DORA requirements as a financial entity, ISO 27001 certification scope includes this system, GDPR data residency constraints

guidedInputs.label: Security tools already deployed
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Okta for IAM, CrowdStrike for EDR, Zscaler for ZTNA, Azure AD Conditional Access, Palo Alto NGFW, Splunk SIEM
